# Rules for AI agents working on this repo

## Commits and pull requests

- Commit as `laaielichter <laaielichter@users.noreply.github.com>`.
- Never add `Claude-Session:` lines, session URLs, `Co-Authored-By:` trailers or
  "Generated with" / "Generated by" lines to commit messages, PR titles or PR descriptions.
- Never put personal data in the repo: no real names, e-mail addresses, local paths,
  machine details, or numbers taken from the maintainer's own computer.

## Everything else

See [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).
